title: Machine Identity and Trust Network — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Verifies the identity, permissions, and credentials of connected agents and services. A proposed trust fabric for the agent economy: every connected agent and service carries verifiable identity, permissions, and credentials, checked at every interaction. No anonymous agents with god privileges; every action traces to an authenticated identity with scoped permissions.
